title: Make the website name configurable and applied consistently

requirements.text: Introduce a single source of truth for the website name (site title/branding string), and ensure it is used consistently for both (a) the browser tab/page title and (b) the only visible on-page text on initial load.
acceptanceCriteria: There is one clearly-defined place to update the website name string (no duplicated hard-coded copies across files).
The browser tab/page title matches the configured website name.
On initial load, the only visible on-page text matches the configured website name exactly (no additional labels, buttons, footers, or helper text).

requirements.text: Add basic HTML metadata that reflects the same website name for common previews/search contexts (e.g., document title and Open Graph title), without adding any additional visible UI text.
acceptanceCriteria: The HTML head contains metadata for the site that uses the same configured website name string (at minimum: title/og:title).
No new visible text appears on the landing page after these metadata changes.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep the landing page minimal: on initial load, the only visible on-page text must be exactly the website name string.
nonGoals: Adding new pages, navigation, buttons, or a chat UI.
Changing backend canister logic or data models.
